newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS raises Valero.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS raises Valero.

text.p: UBS Securities said analyst Ann Kohler upgraded Valero Energy Corp to buy from hold.

-- "We have spent considerable time evaluating the historical and potential yields of the newly acquired Basis refineries and, even with conservative margin assumptions, estimate that these assets will generate strong incremental earnings in both 1997 and 1998."

-- estimated earnings from continuing operations, exclusive of natural gas operations for all of 1997 and inclusive of Basis' asset contribution as of May 1, at $2.00 a share for 1997 and $2.65 for 1998.
